Microsoft (MSFT) compounded revenue at 13.7% a year over 4 years. Did profitability keep up?

SEC financial snapshot · FY2026 (ended Jun 30, 2026)
• Revenue: $331.8B (+17.8% YoY)
• Operating margin: 46.8%
• Free cash flow: $67.0B (20.2% of revenue)

Latest quarter (ended Sep 30, 2026, 10-Q)
• Revenue: $92.3B (+18.8% vs the same quarter a year earlier)
• Operating margin: 49.8%

4-year view (FY2022 → FY2026)
• Revenue: $198.3B → $331.8B
• Operating margin: 42.1% → 46.8%

These are historical financial observations. They do not by themselves establish the drivers of growth, a research thesis or fair value.

Source: Microsoft Form 10-K for FY2026, filed with the SEC on Jul 29, 2026. Reconcile figures to this filing.
